title: Valid palindrome
statement: Return whether s reads the same forwards and backwards after lower-casing letters and ignoring every non-alphanumeric character.
hints: Compare from both ends inward, skipping characters that don't count.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
Was it a car or a cat I saw?

solution.explanation: Two indices from the ends move inward, skipping non-alphanumerics, comparing case-insensitively. O(n) time and O(1) space, unlike building a filtered copy (O(n) space), which is also acceptable if you say so.
